text: The school should adopt the later start time as it offers numerous benefits, particularly in terms of innovation, novelty, and being first. By adopting the later start time, we can ensure full crossing-guard coverage, making our school environment safer and more secure. This move also sets us as the first district statewide to attempt the model, showcasing our commitment to exploring new and better solutions. Additionally, it is anticipated that the pilot school has seen improvements in attendance every term since switching, further emphasizing the potential success of this approach.
